name: InterContinental Bangkok
positioning: High-rise hotel on Phloen Chit Road facing the Erawan Shrine, next to the BTS Skytrain and Bangkok's big shopping malls, with skyline-view rooms from Level 17 up, a rooftop pool 37 stories above the city and a spa with city views
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to central Bangkok's shopping malls and the Erawan Shrine
Guests who like a high-floor room with skyline views
City travelers who want a rooftop pool and a spa above the streets

facts.text: The Erawan Shrine and the Narayana Shrine are right in front of the hotel.
The hotel stands adjacent to the BTS Skytrain.
The hotel is near the centralwOrld, Central Embassy and Siam Paragon shopping malls.
Rooms and suites begin on Level 17, and all of them have views of the Bangkok skyline.
Rooms have pastel silk embroidered bedheads and custom-made furniture.
Bathrooms have deep soaking tubs and separate rain showers.
The Club InterContinental Lounge is on Level 37, with skyline views.
The free-form rooftop pool sits 37 stories above the city.
Signature treatments at SPA InterContinental use Elemis products.
Infinity Fitness has a boxing ring, a stretching zone and city views.
Fireplace Grill and Bar has been at the hotel since 1966.
Summer Palace serves Cantonese cuisine, with an all-you-can-eat dim sum option.

highlights.text: The Erawan Shrine and the Narayana Shrine are right in front of the hotel.
The rooftop pool sits 37 stories above the city, with cocktails and light bites from the Oasis Pool Bar.
Rooms and suites begin on Level 17, and all of them have views of the Bangkok skyline.
Handcrafted artwork in the rooms reflects Thai floral welcoming traditions, with floating flowers as a design feature.
SPA InterContinental sits high above the city, and each of its nine treatment rooms has views of Bangkok.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed, though the hotel can arrange a kennel off the premises on advance request.
WhataHotel notes the busy urban location comes with typical city noise.
